head_commit.message:
R119 author revision: independent Bellman enclosures and complete verified source

Integrate the English ECTA manuscript, full proofs, historical development companion and point-by-point author response. Preserve the frozen A/B/C campaigns, add the separately frozen and actually completed D exact-policy validation, all adverse economic and timing outcomes, complete evidence archives and source-bound validation receipts. Publish the author-package CI workflow without claiming an unobserved CI result. PDF and referee-ready container derivatives will bind this immutable source commit separately.
